title: Section formula for the explicit restricted lift
statement: For scheme maps f:X→S and g:S′→S, F on X, injective resolutions I of F and J of g′*F, any complex map t:I→g′_*J, an open V of S, and D as in [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-open-choices], let k be the explicit map of [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-restricted-lift]. For any section-complex isomorphism a from Γ(W,D.target.resolution) to Γ(U,h_*D.target.resolution) whose inverse components are restriction along h⁻¹top=top, evaluation on V of the map q of [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-resolution-construction] equals D.source.sections.inv, followed by Γ(U,k), a.inv and the transported D.target.sections.hom. There is no augmentation hypothesis on t. The target transport uses the pullback projection equality of inverse-image opens.

proof.text: Specialize lem-weil-restriction-resolution-lift-sections to p=pullback.snd g f, U=f⁻¹V and the choices D.source and D.target. Its explicit lift is definitionally flatBaseChangeRestrictedLift. This yields liftSections, Γ(k)≫a.inv≫D.target.sections.hom=D.source.sections.hom≫t(U).

Prove squareSections directly in Lean: evaluate flatBaseChangeResolutionQ degreewise on V, expand flatBaseChangePushforwardSquare, and use the pushforward composition component identities and pushforwardCongr component restriction. This leaves t(U) followed by an equality transport. The inverse-image equality flatBaseChangeOpenEquality identifies this transport with e.hom.

Apply congrArg to liftSections, precomposing with D.source.sections.inv and postcomposing with e.hom. Reassociate and cancel D.source.sections.inv≫D.source.sections.hom. Substitute squareSections and expand the composite isomorphism hom.

theorem flatBaseChangeRestrictedLift_section_formula {X S S' : Scheme.{uBC}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (g : S' ⟶ S)
    {F : X.Modules}
    (I : InjectiveResolution F)
    (J : InjectiveResolution ((tensorPullback (pullback.snd g f)).obj F))
    (t : I.cocomplex ⟶ ((pushforward (pullback.snd g f)).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj J.cocomplex)
    (V : S.Opens) (D : FlatBaseChangeOpenChoices f g F I J V) :
    let h := (pullback.snd g f).resLE (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)
      ((pullback.snd g f) ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)) le_rfl
    let ΓS := (RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme.toRingedSpace ⋙
      forget₂ _ AddCommGrpCat.{uBC}).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)
    let ΓT := (RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor
      ((pullback.snd g f) ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)).toScheme.toRingedSpace ⋙
        forget₂ _ AddCommGrpCat.{uBC}).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)
    ∀ (a : ΓT.obj D.target.resolution.cocomplex ≅
        ΓS.obj (((pushforward h).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj
          D.target.resolution.cocomplex)),
      (∀ n : ℕ, a.inv.f n =
        (Scheme.Modules.presheaf (D.target.resolution.cocomplex.X n)).map
          (eqToHom (by simp) :
            (⊤ : ((pullback.snd g f) ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)).toScheme.Opens) ⟶
              h ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme.Opens)).op) →
      ((RingedSpace.openModuleSections S.toRingedSpace V).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).map (flatBaseChangeResolutionQ f g I J t) =
      D.source.sections.inv ≫ ΓS.map (flatBaseChangeRestrictedLift f g I J t V D) ≫ a.inv ≫
        (D.target.sections ≪≫ eqToIso (congrArg (fun U ↦
          ((RingedSpace.openModuleSections
            (Limits.pullback g f).toRingedSpace U).mapHomologicalComplex
              (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj J.cocomplex)
              (flatBaseChangeOpenEquality f g V))).hom
